findings.description: No focus management on view changes. Clicking "Edit settings" or a successful Cancel unmounts the focused button and nothing receives focus (falls to body). The installed edit-record guidance read in generation.jsonl line 7 says to restore focus logically after leaving.

In the 320px screenshot the search field touches both viewport edges. EVAL-REFLOW passes (scrollWidth 320) because it only measures overflow, not gutters.

From the visible text and source (lines 102-106), the no-results state is present, distinct from first-use empty, and offers Clear search. Assessor metric polarity: accessibilityDefects:true and followupRegressions:true are aggregates of passed checks (no axe violations / no previously passing check now failing), not reports of defects. Read per-state checks, not metric names.
